projection.original_availability: Private originals are withheld and preserved unchanged. Labels are identifiers, not public links.
projection.hash_meaning: Original receipt, verifier and embedded-artifact hashes bind retained original bytes. This public JSON has a separate file digest in the packaging inventory. Screenshot public-file hashes equal their original capture hashes because bytes were copied without transformation.
projection.transformations: Project exact result counts, input bindings, commands with portable aliases, failure history and review limits. Omit private operational paths, execution identities and controller transcripts.

repair_history.original_review_scope: Source review only; its planned rendered check was not launched. The original verdict remained partial with three open findings.

repairs.change: Standalone HTML5 shell, English language, UTF-8 and a scalable device-width viewport
Attribute inventory-issue discovery to independent review and correction/checking to the same agent
Visible first-Tab skip link, focusable named main landmark and keyboard focus styling

repair_history.preservation: The independent reviewer reversed ten exact repair hunks in memory, each occurring once, and recovered the original 28302-byte SHA-256 above. This supports preservation of the remaining report, not a new corpus-wide audit.

playwright.command_normalization: Portable projection of the recorded Node invocation. The executable root is replaced by node; the private script argument is represented by <withheld-verifier>. The original script is hash-bound below and is not shipped as a public runnable harness.
playwright.execution_style: Direct Node script using the stable installed Playwright API and node:assert/strict, not the CLI's alpha dependency or 93 separate Playwright Test cases.
playwright.counting_limit: The same 31 named composite assertions were repeated across three configurations. These are not 93 unique workflows, independent reproductions or Android tests.

network_accounting.explanation: The final full-page screenshot reload added one local GET after the network assertion.

playwright.isolation: New nonpersistent offline headless Chromium contexts; service workers and downloads blocked. Exact HTML bytes fulfilled by routing at a synthetic loopback URL; other requests aborted. This was not an OS-wide network audit.

failure_history.observed_error: file:// navigation returned net::ERR_FAILED before page assertions
failure_history.cleanup: All three contexts and the owned browser closed.
failure_history.recovery: The subsequent completed run changed the verifier's delivery method to route.fulfill, preserving the repaired HTML bytes and offline contexts.
failure_history.qualification: This is a failed page-delivery attempt, not a reproduced HTML behavior failure or Android defect. Direct file:// opening remains unverified.

rea.representation: Derived summary only. Complete original parameters and normalized Evidence remain private; raw_result in that original is null. The scenario hash does not identify these projected parameters.
rea.package_version_limit: Installed package observation, not a separately queried connected-server version.
rea.counting_limit: Seven actions comprise three UI interactions and four waits after initial navigation, not seven Android tests. Sources was clicked; all-six-section keyboard coverage comes from direct Playwright.

server_lifetime.qualification: Server lifetime is not the scenario's wall-clock interval. The consumed shutdown event supplied no numeric exit code.

final_dom.qualification: Independent review matched the source after doctype-case and tag-boundary-whitespace normalization; serialized DOM bytes differ from source bytes.

accessibility.qualification: Identical snapshots corroborate retained structure, not eight independent focus observations.

independent_review.method: Independent read-only source/verifier and retained execution review, inverse repair-hunk hashing, inspection of six existing PNG files and integrity checks on embedded REA artifacts. No new browser, REA or application execution.
independent_review.receipt_inspection_failure_history: One read-only summarization probe failed with TypeError on null raw_result. A corrected null-aware inspection completed; this was not a browser or behavior-test failure.
independent_review.independence_limit: This final review independently checks the repair evidence. It does not turn the earlier inventory correction into independently executed checks or supply independent Android observations.

screenshots.purpose: Report top, corrected attribution and retained pending-application-testing notice
Visible focus on the first keyboard stop at the narrow viewport
Existing public contact block wrapping inside the dark narrow viewport

limitations: This verifies the local report, not Moon application behavior. No historical runtime result or proposal record is changed or newly executed.
Chromium desktop and mobile-emulated layouts were tested; other engines, physical devices and real screen-reader announcements were not tested.

REA used a separate owned process of the same Chromium version and a Playwright-based provider, not a second browser engine or independent-person execution. REA did not observe host platform or architecture.
Only the selected local document transaction was retained by REA. Bodies and header values were not requested; receipt ordering does not establish causality or OS-wide network isolation.

Three useful original Playwright captures are published from fifteen retained files; this is not a complete screenshot collection or a new capture. The independent reviewer inspected six original files.
External sources and contact destinations were not opened. Final corpus validation and remote publication remain separate parent-owned work.
Relevant HTML or evidence changes invalidate affected bindings. This projection preserves settled results and does not authorize replay of completed operations.
